post.description: Cash pays the amount and the fee, Investments receives them, and the units are added at that cost. A repeated idempotency key returns the buy first recorded with it, recording nothing. A buy that leaves a holding negative at some point in time is recorded all the same, and the response warns about it.
post.summary: Record units of an asset bought with a brokerage account's cash

post.description: Investments pays the amount less the fee and Cash receives it, and the units are removed. The sale stores no basis: the average cost it removes, and its gain, are worked out when read. A repeated idempotency key returns the sale first recorded with it, recording nothing. A sale of more units than are held is recorded all the same, and the response warns about the negative holding.
post.summary: Record units of an asset sold for a brokerage account's cash

post.description: The income category is credited with the value of every unit vested, Investments with that of the units delivered, and the tax category with that of the units withheld; the delivered units are added at their value. Shares sold to cover the tax are a separate sale. A repeated idempotency key returns the vest first recorded with it, recording nothing.
post.summary: Record units of an asset received as compensation in a brokerage account
